newsitem.title: USA: RDO Equipment to buy dealerships assets.
newsitem.headline: RDO Equipment to buy dealerships assets.

text.p: RDO Equipment Co said Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets and assume related liabilities of four agricultural dealerships in Arizona and California.
The company said the dealerships in Yuma, Ehrenberg and Wellton, Arizona, and in Imperial, California, distribute, rent and sell agricultural equipment primarily supplied by Deere & Co.
Financial terms were not disclosed, but the delerships posted total sales of $29 million for the 12 months that ended February 28, RDO equipment said.
The deal is expected to close by June, the company said.
RDO Equipment operates 38 retail stores in seven states.
Its shares were up 3/8 Tuesday at 16.
